mentions.name: git-dataframe-tools
mentions.description: A git extension that turns commit history into a pandas dataframe, enabling programmatic analysis of repository commit data. Built as an experiment with gemini-cli.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I was screwing around with gemini-cli and vibe-coded (or vibe-engineered?) a git extension to turn commit history into a pandas dataframe.

Curious if anyone would find this useful: https://github.com/rbagchi/git-dataframe-tools
